Held jump increments bunny_hop_speed but current_speed interpolation is gated while jump is held. Report main_velocity horizontal speed, not nominal field values.
STEP_HEIGHT_DEFAULT is scene 0.35m; record STEP_HEIGHT_IN_AIR_DEFAULT live rather than assuming initializer copies the scene override.
isolation: Unique fixture-owned CogitoSceneManager.cogito_state_dir set before instancing player and left isolated through shutdown. Remove empty owned root only. Per-instance stamina is_locked and fall_damage=0 prevent unrelated depletion/death during repeated measurements.
